findings.location: Page summary, second paragraph, first sentence: “The algebraic Weyl relations and positivity of a state do not force regularity.”
findings.evidence: The page does not define “regularity” for this Weyl representation. The assigned item cex-qft-nonregular-weyl-state defines strong continuity as norm continuity of each GNS orbit and proves a discontinuous cyclic-vector orbit in every nonzero direction, but does not state that regularity means strong continuity of every one-parameter orbit. Define the term explicitly or replace it with the precise continuity claim.
